name: get_state
summary: The current state: model, camera and microphone status, expressions, items, stage and history.

name: describe_model
summary: The loaded model: parameters (ids, names, ranges, defaults), expressions, motions, items, hotkeys and tracking inputs.

name: get_parameters
summary: Parameter ranges and defaults, and the values agents have set (overrides). Tracked values are not readable.

name: get_mapping
summary: The tracking mapping rules (tracking input → model parameter).

name: list_hotkeys
summary: The model’s hotkeys and what they do.

name: list_items
summary: The items (props) of the loaded model, with visibility, placement and pin.

name: get_log
summary: The latest commands run (by the UI, agents and replays), oldest first.

name: list_commands
summary: Every command with its scope and argument schema.

name: load_model
summary: Loads a model from a URL of a .model3.json file or a .zip (the page fetches it).
details: Local folders cannot be opened by an agent: the browser only reads files the user picks.

name: unload_model
summary: Removes the model from the stage.

name: set_parameters
summary: Sets parameter values that win over tracking, until cleared or until ttl_seconds pass.
details: Values are kept within each parameter’s range by the renderer. Unknown ids are listed in unknown.

ttl_seconds.description: Clear these values after this many seconds.

name: clear_parameters
summary: Removes parameter values set with set_parameters (all, or the ids given), so tracking drives them again.

name: set_expression
summary: Turns an expression on or off (by name, or by .exp3.json path).

name: clear_expressions
summary: Turns every expression off.

name: play_motion
summary: Plays a motion once, or holds its last frame (hold again to release). Name it by group and index, or by name or file.

name.description: The motion’s name or .motion3.json path, as describe_model lists it.

name: stop_motions
summary: Stops the playing motion and releases a held one.

name: list_item_scenes
summary: The item scenes of the loaded model: id, name, group, their items, and whether each is on.

name: set_item_scene
summary: Turns an item scene on (its items show where the scene has them; the other scenes of its group turn off) or off.
details: The scene by id or name. fade: seconds the items take to fade in or out.

name: create_item_scene
summary: Makes an item scene from items as they are placed now: by default every item shown now.

group.description: Turning one scene of a group on turns the group’s others off.

name: remove_item_scene
summary: Removes an item scene (by id or name); its items stay as they are.

name: set_item
summary: Shows or hides an item, places it (main-model units, degrees), puts it in front or behind, or pins it.

pinned.description: Pin to the part of the model under the item’s anchor.

name: fire_hotkey
summary: Fires a hotkey as if its keys were pressed. For "while held" hotkeys, call release_hotkey to let go.

name: release_hotkey
summary: Releases a "while held" hotkey fired with fire_hotkey.

name: set_mapping
summary: Replaces the tracking mapping rules (tracking input → model parameter, with ranges, invert, clamp and smoothing).

input.description: A tracking input id (see describe_model.inputs) or bs.<blendshape>.

followPhysics.description: When physics overwrites the output, write its driver instead (default true).

smoother.description: How smoothing works: "rate" (a rate limit, rising faster than falling) or "exponential". Default: rate for the voice inputs, exponential for the rest.

name: update_mapping_rule
summary: Changes some fields of one mapping rule (by id; get_mapping lists them).

name: calibrate
summary: Calibrates the neutral pose: the person looks straight ahead for about 4.5 s. Needs the camera on (or a phone tracking).

name: set_lip_sync
summary: How the microphone’s lip sync combines with the tracked mouth, its sensitivity and its noise gate.
details: Modes: tracking (camera only), microphone, max, add, blend (weight 0 = camera, 1 = microphone).

type.description: simple: the volume opens the mouth; advanced: vowels too (motion sync).

motionSync.description: Advanced: a setting of the model’s motion-sync file whose shapes move the mouth; empty for the vowel inputs only.

voiceProcessing.description: Advanced: the browser’s echo cancellation and noise suppression.

vowelForm.description: Advanced: the vowels shape the mouth form (I and E widen it, U and O round it).

frequencyWeights.description: Advanced: how much each vowel moves the VoiceFrequency input (an approximation), −1 to 1; it rests at 0.5. Missing vowels keep their weight.

name: set_background
summary: Sets the background: transparent, chroma (key color), color, or image (a data: URL).
details: Applies app-wide, or to the model when it has its own background (per_model).

per_model.description: Give this model its own background and frame cap.

name: set_transform
summary: Places the model: x, y (canvas heights from the centre, y down), zoom (1 = fitted) and rotation (degrees, clockwise).

name: set_frame_cap
summary: Caps the frame rate (0 = uncapped).

name: set_spout
summary: Spout2 output in the desktop app on Windows: up to four outputs, each sent as MochiStudio, MochiStudio2, …
details: Each output is on or off, can be mirrored, and has the stage size unless width and height are given (16 to 7680). get_state shows each sender.

name: set_virtual_camera
summary: The virtual camera in the desktop app (Linux for now): the avatar as a camera named "Mochi Studio Camera" that other apps open.
details: Fields left out keep their value. Sizes: 1280×720, 1920×1080, 960×540; rates: 30 or 60. The background is "stage" (the stage's own) or a #rrggbb color under the avatar (video apps show no transparency). Mirror is off by default: call apps mirror only the person's own preview. get_state.virtualCamera shows the device and what to install when it is missing.

name: collab_host
summary: Opens a collaboration session with the app’s Collab settings, and returns the invitation link and its code.
details: The link and the code (the same invitation, to read aloud) are private: share them only with the people you invite. They are never in get_state. With a password, people also need it to ask to join; it never leaves this app. People who ask appear in get_state.collab.knocks; let them in with collab_answer.

name: collab_join
summary: Asks to join a collaboration session from its invitation link or code.
details: A code uses the app’s Signaling server setting. The host decides; get_state.collab.status is "waiting" until then, then "member", or "ended" with a message.

link.description: The invitation link, or its code.

name: collab_new_link
summary: The host makes a new invitation: the old link and code stop working; people already in stay.

name: collab_chat
summary: Sends a chat message to everyone in the session (text only, at most 500 characters).
details: At most 5 messages in 10 seconds. get_state.collab.chat has the last 50; nothing is kept after the session.

name: collab_leave
summary: Leaves the session (the host ends it for everyone).

name: collab_answer
summary: The host lets someone in who asked to join, or declines.

peer.description: A participant’s id (or nickname), from get_state.collab.

name: collab_remove
summary: The host removes a participant; their app can’t ask again in this session.

peer.description: A participant’s id (or nickname), from get_state.collab.

name: collab_lock
summary: The host locks the session (no one else can ask to join), or opens it again.

name: collab_hide
summary: Hides a participant’s avatar on this screen (and its output views) only, or shows it again.

peer.description: A participant’s id (or nickname), from get_state.collab.

name: collab_place
summary: Places a participant’s avatar on this screen by hand: it stays where it is (or where it is dragged) instead of where they stand, and with pinned, follows this app’s model.
details: Only on this screen and its output views. here: false puts it back where they stand.

peer.description: A participant’s id (or nickname), from get_state.collab.

name: collab_order
summary: Sets this screen’s own front-to-back order of everyone (ids or nicknames, back first), or with none, the shared order again.
details: Only on this screen and its output views; people left out keep the shared order, in front.

items.description: A participant’s id (or nickname), from get_state.collab.

name: collab_block
summary: Blocks a participant on this screen: hidden, and what they send (expressions, motions) is ignored. They aren’t told.

peer.description: A participant’s id (or nickname), from get_state.collab.

name: speak
summary: Plays a sound (WAV, MP3, Ogg…, base64) and moves the mouth with it. Resolves when it ends.
details: Text-to-speech is not built in: send the audio of your own speech. At most 10 MB.

name: screenshot
summary: A PNG of the avatar as it is now, with a transparent background.

name: undo
summary: Undoes the latest change of settings, expressions or parameter values.

name: redo
summary: Runs the latest undone command again.

name: replay_log
summary: Runs logged commands again, in order (control commands only), as get_log returns them.

keep_timing.description: Wait between commands as they were spaced (at most 5 s each).
